verdict.rationale: Ramp documents multi-entity support with entity-level restrictions, role/department/location-based access control (e.g. MCP admin tools restricted by roles/departments/users, OAuth scopes for granular permissions), and dynamic approval routing across departments, indicating a role/permission framework spanning teams, locations, and entities. However, there is no dedicated documentation of a finance-lead-facing granular role/permission builder UI (e.g. custom role creation, permission matrices per location/department) beyond scattered references. Missing for 10: a first-party admin/roles-and-permissions doc page detailing custom role creation, per-location/department permission granularity, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific admin workflow.
